reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is factually correct: processBlock at line 896 hardcodes Opt.none(DataColumnSidecars) instead of passing entry.columns to storeBlock, causing columns from Engine API to be discarded. The 01e property (file: 01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json, lines 733-749) explicitly requires 'After distributed blob publishing, imported columns must behave as if received via gossip.' This is a genuine spec deviation. However, this is a SEMI-TRUSTED boundary issue per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json trust_assumptions.engine_api. Exploitation requires a compromised or buggy local EL (authenticated via JWT) to send malformed data columns. The 01e property marks attacker_controlled=false, confirming this is not directly attacker-triggered. Per Step C2, this is a semi-trusted boundary deviation (type c): the spec violation is real, but the attack prerequisite is compromising a co-located component, reducing severity. Adjusted severity from High to Low per semi-trusted boundary classification rules.
